description: Verify that the RENEWING retransmission interval is (T2 - T1) / 2 (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
If the renewal REQUEST is lost, the client retransmits at half the remaining time to T2. Halving each retx makes the schedule predictable AND keeps later attempts dense as T2 approaches.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND.
2. T1 → RENEWING → renew REQUEST #1.
3. Tester silent (no ACK).
4. After (T2-T1)/2: DUT → wire: renew REQUEST #2   ← key check

[Pass condition]
(t_REQ#2 - t_REQ#1) ≈ (T2 - T1) / 2.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_renewing_retx_interval_out_of_bounds — retx interval outside the tolerance window.

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_second_renewing_request: No DUT second renewing DHCPREQUEST within retx window
verdicts.Fail_renewing_retx_interval_out_of_bound: DUT renewing retx interval out of bounds
